summary: Guest times in E1, E4, E4c, E5, E5b, E7, /manage and /offer said 'Vancouver time' only when the guest's zone was known and different, so every slot-dish guest read a bare 'noon–2 pm' (TSD C5 M2).
fix: guestWhen() always writes '{time} Vancouver time' and adds '({time} your time)' when the guest's clock differs.
